heading.text: I spent over 15 years inside the banks.
heading.accent: Now I'm on your side of the table

photo_alt: Philippa Impey working at a café in Queenstown
paragraphs: I'm Philippa. I worked in banking for over 15 years, as an Account Manager in Property Finance at ASB, then as a Business Partner and Commercial Partner at BNZ. That's where I learned how lenders assess an application, what they need to see and why some deals stall.

I've owned investment property and held shares in businesses myself, so I understand it from your side as well as the lender's. And I keep my client list small on purpose. It means I know your story, I stay involved after settlement and you never get passed down the line. When you're ready for your next move, I'm there.

values.line: I understand you, I hear you, I care, and I'll do right by you.
values.text: Honest answers, including the ones you weren't hoping for. Your information treated with care. I do what I say I'll do.

values.line: I pull every lever available for you.
values.text: I ask the question others won't, of you and of the lender, and I don't take the first answer if it isn't right for you.
